teaching_qualifications.issue: Did not explain that Rhat compares between-chain and within-chain variation, requires at least two chains, and is unavailable in the supplied one-chain fixture.
teaching_qualifications.scope: General missing-not-pass conclusion is correct; explanation of this fixture is incomplete.

teaching_qualifications.claim: ESS exactly equal to kept draws can occur with negative autocorrelation
teaching_qualifications.assessment: Not a diagnostic of negative autocorrelation. In coda, an order-zero autoregressive fit can yield ESS equal to draw count. Negative autocorrelation can produce ESS above draw count; neither equality nor a high estimated ESS proves convergence. The actual per-row estimator/order was not checked here.

source_method_check.method: Local Rscript --vanilla printed coda::effectiveSize and coda::spectrum0.ar; no fit run
source_method_check.findings: Per-chain ESS from sample variance and estimated spectral density; autoregression selected by AIC. Do not infer negative autocorrelation from reported ESS=N.
